paragraphs.en: When one wishes to play the wit, he sometimes wanders from the truth. I have not been entirely honest about the lamplighters. If two billion people stood in a crowded square twenty miles long and wide, they could fit into such an area.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个人想要卖弄机智时，有时会偏离事实。我并没有完全说实话关于那些点灯人。如果两 billion 人挤在一个二十英里见方的广场上，他们确实可以全部容纳进去。

paragraphs.en: The grown-ups will not believe you; they think they occupy much space. You should advise them to calculate it themselves—figures please them.
paragraphs.zh: 大人是不会相信你的；他们自认为占据了很大的空间。你应该建议他们自己计算一下——给他们看一些数据吧。

paragraphs.en: Upon arriving on Earth, the little prince was surprised by its emptiness. He feared he had landed on the wrong planet until a golden snake appeared in the moonlight.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子来到地球后感到十分惊讶，发现这里显得异常空旷。他担心自己可能降落在了错误的星球上，直到一道月光下金色的蛇出现了。

paragraphs.en: "Good evening," said the little prince courteously.
paragraphs.zh: “晚上好，”小王子礼貌地说。

paragraphs.en: "Good evening," replied the snake.
paragraphs.zh: “晚上好。”蛇应道。

paragraphs.en: "This is the Earth, Africa," the snake explained.
paragraphs.zh: “这是地球，非洲，”那条蛇解释道。

paragraphs.en: "Are there no people here?" asked the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “这里没有人吗？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "There are none in the desert. The Earth is vast," the snake answered.
paragraphs.zh: “沙漠中没有了，大地如此广阔。”蛇回答道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince sat on a stone and looked at the stars. "Do the stars guide us back to our homes? My planet is up there, but it seems so distant."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子坐在一块石头上，凝视着星空。“是星星引领我们回到家园吗？我的星球就在上面，却显得如此遥远。”

paragraphs.en: "It's beautiful," said the snake. "Why did you come here?"
paragraphs.zh: “真美啊，”那条蛇说道，“你为什么要来这里？”

paragraphs.en: "I had trouble with a flower," replied the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “我遇到了一朵花的问题。”小王子回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Ah!" said the snake.
paragraphs.zh: “啊！”蛇叫道。

paragraphs.en: They fell silent for a while.
paragraphs.zh: 他们沉默了片刻。

paragraphs.en: "Why are there no people?" the little prince asked again.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么这里没有人？”小王子再次问道。

paragraphs.en: "It's lonely in the desert..."
paragraphs.zh: “沙漠中真是寂寞……”

paragraphs.en: "And among men too," added the snake.
paragraphs.zh: “就连人类也是如此,”蛇补充道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince stared at the snake. "You're peculiar, you know. You're thinner than my finger."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子盯着那条蛇看，“你可真怪，比我的手指还要细。”

paragraphs.en: The snake declared, "I am more powerful than a king's finger."
paragraphs.zh: 蛇宣称：“我的力量胜过国王的指尖。”

paragraphs.en: The little prince smiled. "You are not powerful. You have no feet and cannot travel."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子笑了笑：“你不够强大。你没有脚，无法远行。”

paragraphs.en: "But I can carry you farther than any ship," the snake replied, coiling around the little prince’s ankle.
paragraphs.zh: “但我能带你去比任何船只更远的地方，”那条蛇回答着，绕上了小王子的脚踝。

paragraphs.en: "Only those I touch return to their home star," the snake continued. "But you are innocent and come from a distant planet..."
paragraphs.zh: “只有我触碰过的才会返回各自的星辰母星，”蛇继续说道，“而你则是无辜的，来自遥远的星球……”

paragraphs.en: The little prince remained silent.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子沉默不语。

paragraphs.en: "You move me with pity—so weak on this granite Earth," the snake said. "One day, if you miss your own planet too much, I can help you."
paragraphs.zh: “你让我心生怜悯——在这片坚硬的岩石之上如此虚弱，”那条蛇说道，“如果你有一天太思念自己的星球，我可以帮助你。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh! I understand you well," the little prince replied. "But why do you always speak in riddles?"
paragraphs.zh: “哦！我明白你的意思了，”小王子回答，“但你为什么总是爱卖关子呢？”

paragraphs.en: "I solve them all," the snake responded.
paragraphs.zh: “我全都解决了。”蛇回答道。

paragraphs.en: They fell into silence.
paragraphs.zh: 他们陷入了沉默。
